---
title: "B/BMSY hindcast — raw ggplot templates"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  study_id: "sma-natl"
  scenario_id: "Scenario-1"
  marginal_year: 2024
  demo_peel: "-20"
  figure_set: "paper"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 6
)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(file.path(root, "studies"))) {
  root <- normalizePath(file.path(root, ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}
source(file.path(root, "R", "project.R"), local = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "R", "backtest-mvln.R"), local = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "R", "backtest-peel-panels.R"), local = TRUE)
load_sstruth()

cfg <- backtest_config(
  study_id = params$study_id,
  scenario_id = params$scenario_id,
  root = root
)
bt <- load_backtest_results(params$study_id, params$scenario_id, root)

full_last <- tryCatch({
  rep <- r4ss::SS_output(cfg$run_dir, verbose = FALSE)
  sstruth::assessmentMaxYear(rep)
}, error = function(e) NA_integer_)

marginal_year <- .resolve_marginal_year(
  bt,
  params$marginal_year,
  full_last = full_last
)
demo_peel <- as.character(params$demo_peel)

# --- colours & labels (edit here) ---
peel_levels <- c("0", "-5", "-10", "-20")
peel_cols <- .peel_colours(peel_levels)
peel_labels <- stats::setNames(
  vapply(peel_levels, .peel_display_label, character(1)),
  peel_levels
)

scenario_levels <- .backtest_scenario_levels()
scenario_cols <- .backtest_scenario_colours()
scenario_labels <- .backtest_scenario_labels()

fig_dir <- figure_dir(params$figure_set, "robustness")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
line_w <- 1.1

clip_year <- function(d) {
  if (!NROW(d) || !is.finite(full_last)) {
    return(d)
  }
  d[d$year <= full_last, , drop = FALSE]
}

# --- deterministic trajectories (all harvest scenarios) ---
traj <- bt$forecasts$trajectories %>%
  filter(
    forecast_scenario %in% scenario_levels,
    peel %in% peel_levels,
    is.finite(bratio)
  ) %>%
  clip_year() %>%
  mutate(
    peel = factor(as.character(peel), levels = peel_levels),
    forecast_scenario = factor(forecast_scenario, levels = scenario_levels),
    era = factor(era, levels = c("TIME", "FORE"))
  )

# --- peel MVLN (retro Hessian; shared across scenarios on fit years) ---
peel_mvln <- bt$mvln$bratio %>%
  filter(as.character(peel) %in% peel_levels) %>%
  clip_year() %>%
  mutate(peel = factor(as.character(peel), levels = peel_levels))

# --- forecast MVLN (hindcast Hessian; scenario-specific) ---
forecast_mvln <- bind_rows(lapply(scenario_levels, function(fc) {
  tbl <- .forecast_bratio_mvln_tbl(bt, fc, use_forecast_mvln = TRUE)
  if (!NROW(tbl)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  tbl %>%
    filter(as.character(peel) %in% peel_levels) %>%
    clip_year() %>%
    mutate(
      peel = factor(as.character(peel), levels = peel_levels),
      forecast_scenario = fc
    )
})) %>%
  mutate(forecast_scenario = factor(forecast_scenario, levels = scenario_levels))

# --- MVLN draws at terminal year ---
mvln_draws <- function(peels, scenarios) {
  bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(fc) {
    bind_rows(lapply(peels, function(pl) {
      v <- .forecast_bratio_draws(
        cfg, bt, pl, marginal_year,
        forecast_scenario = fc,
        use_forecast_mvln = TRUE
      )
      if (!length(v)) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      data.frame(
        peel = factor(pl, levels = peel_levels),
        forecast_scenario = fc,
        value = v,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
  })) %>%
    mutate(forecast_scenario = factor(forecast_scenario, levels = scenario_levels))
}

mvln_ci_at_year <- function(mvln_tbl, peels, scenarios) {
  mvln_tbl %>%
    filter(
      as.character(peel) %in% peels,
      forecast_scenario %in% scenarios,
      year == marginal_year
    ) %>%
    select(peel, forecast_scenario, br_lo, br_hi, br_median)
}

y_limits <- function(...) {
  vals <- unlist(list(...))
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  rng <- range(vals)
  pad <- diff(rng) * 0.05
  if (!is.finite(pad) || pad <= 0) {
    pad <- max(abs(rng)) * 0.05
  }
  rng + c(-pad, pad)
}

# Horizontal MVLN density polygons at terminal year (same y scale as trajectories)
marginal_density_polygons <- function(
  draws,
  group_col,
  x_year,
  x_width = 2.5
) {
  if (!NROW(draws)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  groups <- unique(draws[[group_col]])
  pieces <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
    v <- draws$value[draws[[group_col]] == g]
    v <- v[is.finite(v)]
    if (length(v) < 2L) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    dens <- stats::density(v)
    if (!any(is.finite(dens$y)) || max(dens$y, na.rm = TRUE) <= 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    w <- x_width * dens$y / max(dens$y, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(
      year = c(rep(x_year, length(dens$x)), x_year + rev(w)),
      bratio = c(dens$x, rev(dens$x)),
      group = g,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  pieces <- pieces[!vapply(pieces, is.null, logical(1))]
  if (!length(pieces)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  out <- bind_rows(pieces)
  names(out)[names(out) == "group"] <- group_col
  out[[group_col]] <- factor(out[[group_col]], levels = levels(draws[[group_col]]))
  out
}

marginal_marker_segments <- function(
  ci,
  det,
  group_col,
  x_year,
  x_width = 2.5,
  tick = 0.12
) {
  if (!NROW(ci)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  det <- det[, c(group_col, "bratio"), drop = FALSE]
  names(det)[2] <- "det"
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ci)), function(i) {
    g <- ci[[group_col]][i]
    dv <- det$det[match(as.character(g), as.character(det[[group_col]]))]
    data.frame(
      bratio = c(ci$br_lo[i], ci$br_hi[i], ci$br_median[i], dv),
      kind = c("br_lo", "br_hi", "br_median", "det"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  seg <- bind_rows(rows)
  seg[[group_col]] <- ci[[group_col]]
  seg$x0 <- x_year
  seg$x1 <- x_year + tick
  seg <- seg[is.finite(seg$bratio), , drop = FALSE]
  seg$linetype <- ifelse(
    seg$kind == "det",
    "dotdash",
    ifelse(seg$kind == "br_median", "solid", "dashed")
  )
  seg$linewidth <- ifelse(seg$kind == "br_median", 0.9, 0.6)
  seg
}
```

Generic layers:

- **Ribbon** = MVLN 5–95% (`br_lo`–`br_hi`)
- **Dashed line** = MVLN median (`br_median`)
- **Dashed/solid line** = deterministic fit (`TIME`) / projection (`FORE`)
- **Marginal strip** = horizontal MVLN density at `marginal_year` (same y axis as trajectories) + CI / median / deterministic ticks

All series are clipped at **`r if (is.finite(full_last)) full_last else "the assessment terminal year"`** (last year of the unpeeled assessment).

---

## Utility 1 — reported catch by peel

One harvest scenario (`catchReported`); colour = retrospective peel. MVLN ribbon uses the peel retro Hessian (fit years); marginals at **`r marginal_year`**.

```{r fig-catch-by-peel, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
fc <- "catchReported"
peels <- peel_levels
marg_w <- 2.5

rib <- filter(peel_mvln, peel %in% peels)
trT <- filter(traj, forecast_scenario == fc, peel %in% peels, era == "TIME")
trF <- filter(traj, forecast_scenario == fc, peel %in% peels, era == "FORE")
drw <- mvln_draws(peels, fc)
ci  <- mvln_ci_at_year(forecast_mvln, peels, fc)
det <- filter(traj, forecast_scenario == fc, peel %in% peels, year == marginal_year)
dens_poly <- marginal_density_polygons(drw, "peel", marginal_year, marg_w)
mark_seg <- marginal_marker_segments(ci, det, "peel", marginal_year, tick = 0.15)

y_lim <- y_limits(
  rib$br_lo, rib$br_hi, rib$br_median,
  trT$bratio, trF$bratio, drw$value
)
x_lim <- range(c(trT$year, trF$year, rib$year, marginal_year + marg_w))

fig_catch_by_peel <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = rib,
    aes(x = year, ymin = br_lo, ymax = br_hi, fill = peel),
    alpha = 0.18,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = rib,
    aes(x = year, y = br_median, colour = peel, group = peel),
    linewidth = line_w * 0.85,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = trT,
    aes(x = year, y = bratio, colour = peel, group = peel),
    linewidth = line_w * 0.75,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = trF,
    aes(x = year, y = bratio, colour = peel, group = peel),
    linewidth = line_w,
    linetype = "solid"
  ) +
  {
    if (!is.null(dens_poly) && NROW(dens_poly)) {
      geom_polygon(
        data = dens_poly,
        aes(x = year, y = bratio, fill = peel),
        alpha = 0.25,
        colour = NA
      )
    }
  } +
  {
    if (!is.null(mark_seg) && NROW(mark_seg)) {
      geom_segment(
        data = mark_seg,
        aes(
          x = x0,
          xend = x1,
          y = bratio,
          yend = bratio,
          colour = peel,
          linetype = linetype,
          linewidth = linewidth
        ),
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
    }
  } +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = marginal_year,
    colour = "grey40",
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = peel_cols, labels = peel_labels, name = "Peel") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = peel_cols, labels = peel_labels, guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim, ylim = y_lim) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(scenario_labels[[fc]], " — ", cfg$scenario_label),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Marginal MVLN density at ", marginal_year,
      " shares y axis; ticks = 5/95%, median, deterministic"
    ),
    x = "Year",
    y = "B/BMSY"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(fig_catch_by_peel)
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "backtest-bratio-catch-by-peel.png"),
  fig_catch_by_peel,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 200
)
```

## Utility 2 — peel 20 yr by harvest scenario

Single peel (`r peel_labels[[demo_peel]]`); colour = reported catch, $F=0$, $F=FMSY$. Scenario-specific MVLN where available.

```{r fig-peel20-by-scenario, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
pl <- demo_peel
scenarios <- scenario_levels
marg_w <- 2.5

rib <- filter(forecast_mvln, peel == pl, forecast_scenario %in% scenarios)
trT <- filter(traj, peel == pl, forecast_scenario %in% scenarios, era == "TIME")
trF <- filter(traj, peel == pl, forecast_scenario %in% scenarios, era == "FORE")
drw <- mvln_draws(pl, scenarios)
ci  <- mvln_ci_at_year(forecast_mvln, pl, scenarios)
det <- filter(traj, peel == pl, forecast_scenario %in% scenarios, year == marginal_year)
dens_poly <- marginal_density_polygons(drw, "forecast_scenario", marginal_year, marg_w)
mark_seg <- marginal_marker_segments(ci, det, "forecast_scenario", marginal_year, tick = 0.15)

y_lim <- y_limits(
  rib$br_lo, rib$br_hi, rib$br_median,
  trT$bratio, trF$bratio, drw$value
)
x_lim <- range(c(trT$year, trF$year, rib$year, marginal_year + marg_w))

fig_peel20_by_scenario <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = rib,
    aes(x = year, ymin = br_lo, ymax = br_hi, fill = forecast_scenario),
    alpha = 0.18,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = rib,
    aes(x = year, y = br_median, colour = forecast_scenario, group = forecast_scenario),
    linewidth = line_w * 0.85,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = trT,
    aes(x = year, y = bratio, colour = forecast_scenario, group = forecast_scenario),
    linewidth = line_w * 0.75,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = trF,
    aes(x = year, y = bratio, colour = forecast_scenario, group = forecast_scenario),
    linewidth = line_w,
    linetype = "solid"
  ) +
  {
    if (!is.null(dens_poly) && NROW(dens_poly)) {
      geom_polygon(
        data = dens_poly,
        aes(x = year, y = bratio, fill = forecast_scenario),
        alpha = 0.25,
        colour = NA
      )
    }
  } +
  {
    if (!is.null(mark_seg) && NROW(mark_seg)) {
      geom_segment(
        data = mark_seg,
        aes(
          x = x0,
          xend = x1,
          y = bratio,
          yend = bratio,
          colour = forecast_scenario,
          linetype = linetype,
          linewidth = linewidth
        ),
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
    }
  } +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = marginal_year,
    colour = "grey40",
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scenario_cols, labels = scenario_labels, name = "Harvest") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_cols, labels = scenario_labels, guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim, ylim = y_lim) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(peel_labels[[pl]], " — ", cfg$scenario_label),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Marginal MVLN density at ", marginal_year,
      " shares y axis; ticks = 5/95%, median, deterministic"
    ),
    x = "Year",
    y = "B/BMSY"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(fig_peel20_by_scenario)
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "backtest-bratio-peel20-by-scenario.png"),
  fig_peel20_by_scenario,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 200
)
```
